plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Sociology (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2026/04/03. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. The PDF lists both new and old course numbers; the new numbers are used as the seed codes. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 16+16+16+15+15+15+15+12 = 120; all printed semester totals reconcile with the course rows and the plan prints TOTAL: 120. CORRECTION: Junior Spring prints the slot 'Theory/Directed Elective' (3 hrs, no course number) alongside 'SCWK 38133 SW 3103 Statistics' (3 hrs); the seed had wrongly assigned SCWK 38133 to the slot. The slot is now an ELECTIVE placeholder per the file's convention; SCWK 38133 Statistics kept as printed. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
